events.summary: Sorin is forced to end Avacyn, whom he had created.
events.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

events.summary: Rebels, unable to breach the castle, depose the pretender king Lalor the Obstinate from within.
events.quote: When the rebels couldn't breach the castle to kill Lalor the Obstinate, they tried a more internal approach to depose the pretender king.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet dies and the city mourns, but he leaves components for his rebirth.
events.quote: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

events.summary: Rorica breaks with her order over the creation of the wolfir and leads a crusade against reformed werewolves.
events.quote: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

events.summary: Ral's storm detects planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.
events.quote: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

events.summary: Wasitora, once a fierce foe, becomes one of Madara's greatest protectors.
events.quote: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

events.summary: Toralf strikes the ground with his hammer and destroys a demonic horde.
events.quote: "Toralf struck the ground with his hammer, and the force of a thousand storms tore through the demonic horde." —Birgi, god of storytelling

events.summary: Olka learns the essence of evening mist and can vanish with a thought.
events.quote: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets.

events.summary: Yargle did not expect Muldrotha to appear.
events.quote: Yargle hadn't bargained on her showing up.

relations.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

relations.note: It fell upon Sorin to end Avacyn forever
relations.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed." —Multani

relations.note: Elesh Norn addresses Sheoldred about uniting flesh
relations.quote: "Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it." —Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
"He is Yawgmoth's reward to me. I shall kill him a hundred times a day." —Crovax, to Ertai
"Yes, Boros tactics are unparalleled. But when your comrades are dying around you, inner strength must carry the day." —Gideon Jura, to Aurelia
Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

relations.note: Becomes one of Madara's greatest protectors
relations.quote: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity." —Senifet, vizier of Bontu
"We in the Conclave have a saying: 'When you hold a shield, lend your shield.' The strong must never forget what they owe to the weak." —Niszka, Selesnya evangel

relations.note: Tajic sent Mileva to the Tenth
relations.quote: "The Tenth is under heavy attack, but it's being handled. I sent Mileva." —Tajic

rejected.summary: Light descends and a voice promises a soldier he will not fall.
rejected.quote: Light streaked down from the heavens, and a voice whispered in the soldier's ear: "You shall not fall today."

rejected.note: Queen of the faeries of Glen Elendra
rejected.quote: Deep in Glen Elendra blossoms Oona, queen of the faeries, nourished by secrets and pollinated by stolen dreams.
